en.headline: Observatory extends Thunderstorm Warning until 3pm
en.dek: The warning first issued at 9.40am was prolonged again after isolated thunderstorms continued to be forecast over Hong Kong, the Observatory said.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory said the Thunderstorm Warning issued at 9.40am on Sunday had been extended until 3pm after isolated thunderstorms were still expected over the territory.

The warning had earlier been prolonged until 1pm. Members of the public were advised to seek safe shelter if outdoors, leave the water and avoid outdoor swimming or water sports, and stay away from high ground and highly conductive objects.
Areas of thundery showers continued to develop to the west of the Pearl River Estuary and could affect Hong Kong, the Observatory said earlier in the day.

zh.headline: 天文台將雷暴警告延長至下午3時
zh.dek: 天文台上午9時40分發出的雷暴警告再延長至下午3時，預料本港有局部地區雷暴。
body: 香港天文台表示，周日上午9時40分發出的雷暴警告已延長至下午3時，預料本港仍有局部地區雷暴。
警告早前曾延長至下午1時。天文台提醒市民如身處室外請到安全地方躲避，離開水面，切勿在戶外游泳或進行其他戶外水上運動，亦勿站立於高地或接近導電物體、樹木或桅杆。
天文台較早前指，珠江口以西持續有雷雨區發展，可能影響本港。
